mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect 53-degree weather with overcast skies near Verona Area High School. We are looking at a low of 46 degrees overnight with no rain. Also, the ISS is passing overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

For city updates, the Verona Police Department reported an arrest last Thursday involving a school bus driver for O W I, with no reported injuries to students. Additionally, the city reminds residents that updated zoning maps and information on the four polling locations are available on the city website to help you prepare for upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do around town starting tomorrow with live music at Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can catch the Dane County Farmer's Market this Friday at the Capitol, plus trivia nights at The Bogey Factory and Paddy Mac's early next week.
Last Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department took a school bus driver into custody for O W I after reports of erratic driving while students were on board.

Today's flavor was the fan-favorite Crazy for Cookie Dough. Since the store is now closed for the night, please join us tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM, when the featured flavor will be OREO REESE'S Cheesecake.
